vram_read.how: a kernel that reads the buffer and sums it (the ceiling a memory-bound decode step has)

vram_copy.how: cuMemcpyDtoD of the buffer: bytes copied a second (read and written both)

link_h2d_pinned.how: cuMemcpyHtoD from pinned host memory (what the expert cache's copies use)

link_h2d_pageable.how: cuMemcpyHtoD from pageable memory (the driver stages it)

vram_product.how: the engine's product at one row over 19 packs of the directory's first layers, back to back (what a decode step reads weights at)

ram_read.how: 32 thread(s) summing a buffer of u64

ram_read_1_thread.how: 1 thread(s) summing a buffer of u64

ssd_read_16.how: random 2 MiB spans of the directory's safetensors files, 16 at a time, direct reads (src/disk.rs, the SSD tier's reader)

ssd_read_1.how: random 2 MiB spans of the directory's safetensors files, 1 at a time, direct reads (src/disk.rs, the SSD tier's reader)
